lead_raw_text:
The structure of CoAsP crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Co4As4P4) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for all three elements: Co centers are surrounded by four As neighbors, As centers by four Co and four P neighbors, and P centers by four Co neighbors, all near 2.34–2.42 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show corner-sharing between As and P tetrahedra, as well as between Co and As tetrahedra.
